tools.name: payment-intelligence_open-banking-transaction-classify
tools.description: Classify supplied transactions using description, merchant, category, and amount-sign hints. No bank connection is used. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/payment-intelligence/open-banking-transaction-classify. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: payment-intelligence_recurring-detect
tools.description: Detect repeating merchant and amount patterns from supplied transaction dates. Cadence is labeled from spacing only. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/payment-intelligence/recurring-detect. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: payment-intelligence_subscription-spend-identify
tools.description: Identify subscription candidates from recurring cadence and subscription wording in supplied merchants or descriptions. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/payment-intelligence/subscription-spend-identify. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: payment-intelligence_merchant-identity-resolve
tools.description: Match transaction merchants against a caller-supplied directory. Unmatched names keep the supplied transaction text. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/payment-intelligence/merchant-identity-resolve. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: payment-intelligence_income-stability-analyze
tools.description: Summarize labeled income credits by month and report variability from supplied amounts only. Income is never invented. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/payment-intelligence/income-stability-analyze. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: payment-intelligence_affordability-data-calculate
tools.description: Calculate inflow, outflow, subscription estimates, and income ratios from supplied transactions. No affordability decision is returned. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/payment-intelligence/affordability-data-calculate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: payment-intelligence_failure-pattern-analyze
tools.description: Find failed, declined, or returned payment wording and statuses in supplied transactions and group counts by merchant text. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/payment-intelligence/failure-pattern-analyze. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: payment-intelligence_transaction-categorization-correct
tools.description: Apply caller-supplied category corrections to matching transaction ids or merchants without inventing categories. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/payment-intelligence/transaction-categorization-correct. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: payment-intelligence_account-cashflow-compare
tools.description: Consolidate inflow and outflow by account and compare pairs only when currencies match. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/payment-intelligence/account-cashflow-compare. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: payment-intelligence_iban-validate
tools.description: Validate IBAN structure and mod-97 checksum using public IBAN Registry lengths, and parse domestic bank/account fields for GB, DE, FR, and NL. Bank legal names are not looked up from a live directory. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/payment-intelligence/iban-validate. An unpaid call returns the x402

tools.name: payment-intelligence_routing-number-validate
tools.description: Validate a 9-digit US ABA routing number checksum (weights 3-7-1). Bank directory names are not returned in this version. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/payment-intelligence/routing-number-validate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: payment-intelligence_financial-data-quality-audit
tools.description: Combine classification, recurring spend, merchants, income, failures, corrections, cashflow, and missing-field checks from supplied records. Price $0.12 USDC. POST /api/v1/payment-intelligence/financial-data-quality-audit. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "payment-intelligence" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: payment-intelligence_open-banking-transaction-classify · Private data: payment-intelligence_financial-data-quality-audit · Public sink: payment-intelligence_open-banking-transaction-classify, payment-intelligence_recurring-detect, payment-intelligence_subscription-spend-identify, payment-intelligence_merchant-identity-resolve, payment-intelligence_income-stability-analyze, payment-intelligence_affordability-data-calculate, payment-intelligence_failure-pattern-analyze, payment-intelligence_transaction-categorization-correct, payment-intelligence_account-cashflow-compare, payment-intelligence_iban-validate, payment-intelligence_routing-number-validate, payment-intelligence_financial-data-quality-audit · Destructive: payment-intelligence_open-banking-transaction-classify, payment-intelligence_recurring-detect, payment-intelligence_subscription-spend-identify, payment-intelligence_merchant-identity-resolve, payment-intelligence_income-stability-analyze, payment-intelligence_affordability-data-calculate, payment-intelligence_failure-pattern-analyze, payment-intelligence_transaction-categorization-correct, payment-intelligence_account-cashflow-compare, payment-intelligence_iban-validate, payment-intelligence_routing-number-validate, payment-intelligence_financial-data-quality-audit.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
